data.gender_notes: Najlah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'najala' meaning 'to be light, soft, gentle, or graceful.' In Islamic context, Najlah symbolizes the gentle and loving nature of Allah towards His creation. The name Najlah carries the meaning “Graceful, gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Najlah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A gentle reminder of Allah's mercy and kindness towards His creatures.
